ownership.quote: Azure Container Apps is a fully managed serverless container service offered by Microsoft Azure.

stage.note: Azure Container Apps is a product/service line within Microsoft Azure, itself part of publicly traded Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ: MSFT). Not independently funded; no separate accelerator, funding round, or stage applies.

revenue.basis: Microsoft FY2025 Q4 earnings press release; figure is total Microsoft company quarterly revenue, not specific to Azure Container Apps or even Azure alone. Azure and other cloud services revenue grew 39% in the quarter and 'Azure surpassed $75 billion in revenue' for the fiscal year, per the same release, but Azure Container Apps' own revenue is not separately disclosed.
revenue.quote: Revenue was $76.4 billion and increased 18% (up 17% in constant currency)... this year, Azure surpassed $75 billion in revenue, up 34 percent

note: Azure Container Apps is a managed serverless container platform within Microsoft Azure, part of Microsoft Corporation (public company, NASDAQ: MSFT). It has no independent funding history, accelerator participation, or standalone revenue disclosure; all figures roll up into Microsoft's consolidated and Azure segment results.
